title: Schwert der Gnade
prompt:
Create one original premium botanical-metal book illustration for OLIVA, a calm Christian Bible reading companion. Use the attached project-owned Gospel-of-John image ONLY as a reference for the refined painterly realism, warm silver / pale aged brass / muted olive-grey linen materials, restrained Mediterranean light, full-object upright portrait composition and consistent illustrated family. Develop a DISTINCT new symbolic book-sword for Paul's Letter to the Romans, titled in our metadata “Sword of Grace”. Do not add any text to the image.

One single elegant slender ceremonial sword stands upright vertically, pointed blade above and handle below. Entire object clearly visible, with generous transparent margins above its tip and below its rounded pommel; centered portrait canvas, ideally1024x1536. This is a quiet artistic symbol for understanding and orientation, never violence or a weapon trophy. The Romans-specific design is a refined BRIDGE: the aged pale-brass crossguard is one beautifully crafted shallow open arch that visually bridges two ends with a continuous smooth curve, with a very small simple open oval at its center. It should read as plausible subtle metal craftsmanship, not architecture attached to a weapon. The grip is wrapped in warm grey-olive linen with a few very restrained pale gold joins; its small rounded pommel is plain and softly worn. The clean warm brushed-silver blade has a narrow warm-gold central inlay and a very fine modest lengthwise engraved line, no glowing magical effects. A single slender olive twig, with naturally elongated silver-green leaves, gently drapes along the LOWER crossguard and rises a little beside the lower blade, creating a quiet connected arc. No grapevine leaves, no grape clusters, no flowers or fruit: distinguish it from the John reference. The top two thirds of the blade remain mostly clear, with an extremely fine, legible silhouette and tactile painted metal texture.

The theme comes from Romans3:23–24 (grace without merit) and Romans5:1 (peace with God), with Romans8:1 as an additional reading reference. The bridge-shaped craft detail and olive twig are our free artistic interpretation, not objects described in those verses. Do not depict a biblical scene, God, a human, religious authority or a historical reconstruction. We are not implying achievement earns grace. Mature premium consumer-app art direction: warm cream / olive / sand / restrained gold, meticulous botanical naturalist detail, quiet dimensionality, sophisticated material highlights readable on a phone. Cohesive with the provided John project art but an individual Roman book identity. No blood, battle, armour, hands, people, trophies, combat poses, aggression, gemstones, ranks, neon, fantasy game effects, halos, wings, crowns, religious emblems, inscriptions, lettering, numbers, pseudo-scripture, frame, pedestal, ground plane or dropped cast shadow. Preserve a TRUE transparent background and isolated RGBA-style appearance. Do not paint a dark, cream, gradient or checkerboard background. Soft modelling belongs inside the painted object, not a large external glow.

und werden ohne Verdienst gerecht aus seiner Gnade durch die Erlösung, so durch Jesum Christum geschehen ist,
